prompt:
Fix snippets/author-byline.liquid so that it renders an article author byline. Inputs (all top-level, no section.settings): - `author` (object, always present) with exactly two keys, both always present: - `author.name`: string or null - `author.url`: string or null Rules: 1. Compute the display name as `author.name` with leading and trailing whitespace removed. A null name counts as empty. 2. If the display name is empty, output nothing at all (empty string). 3. Otherwise output exactly one element: - If `author.url` is a non-empty string: `

By NAME

` - If `author.url` is null or the empty string: `

By NAME

` NAME is the trimmed display name. URL is `author.url` exactly as given and is not trimmed. 4. HTML-escape both NAME and URL with Liquid's `escape` filter, so & < > " ' become & < > " '. 5. Emit no whitespace or newlines outside the element. The text inside the paragraph is the word `By`, one space, then the link or span. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Change only snippets/author-byline.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
